rca_of_issue: REVIEWED FIXES (all verified): (1) Keyboard overlap - root cause: question content sat in a scroll view whose bottom padding didn't account for the sticky footer, so with the keyboard open the Yes/No row was pinned under the 'Generate My Profile' footer. Fix: flex:1 KeyboardAwareScrollView + dynamic paddingBottom=measured footer height+24 + KeyboardStickyView footer; verified via computed DOM styles (95px padding) and real hit-test click on 'Yes'. (2) Navigation loop - root cause: /subscription auth gate's back went to the paywall and the paywall had no way back, bouncing users between sign-in and paywall. Fix: paywall back arrow setScreen(23) + AuthGateStep honors from=onboarding via router.replace('/onboarding') resuming at screen 25. Verified live: email gate -> paywall -> 20/20 -> forward to /subscription again. (3) 502 on Create Account - root cause: provider 429 rate limit surfaced as generic 502. Fix: server.py send_email maps 429 -> HTTP 429 friendly message; unit tests prove mapping + OTP-record cleanup; live send healthy (200).
